programme.title: Shameless
programme.sub-title: Can it be a little more? / Darfs ein bisschen mehr sein?
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives together with his six children as a single father. However, he spends most of the time in the bar and gives the little money to the family, instead of eating for alcohol for food. His oldest daughter Fiona is inevitably overturning the mother role for her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile debbie, the 10-year violent Carl and the little Liam. Together, despite their impossible father, the children try to master their lives on creative, scandalosis, but also warmly. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Der Henker
programme.desc: Tyrol, at the beginning of the 16th century: there is a lot of hustle and bustle on the market square. Two boys run around the stood with a laugh - orphans who grow up in the monastery. They hide under the scaffold, from there you can get the execution from Nachster. After years of age, however, the paths of the two foundlings Martin and Georg separate under the care of Monchen. / Tirol, Anfang des 16. Jahrhunderts: Am Marktplatz herrscht reges Treiben. Zwei Jungen laufen lachend zwischen den Standen umher - Waisenkinder, die im Kloster aufwachsen. Sie verstecken sich unter dem Schafott, von dort bekommt man die Hinrichtung aus nachster Nahe mit. Nach gemeinsam verbrachten Jahren unter der Obhut von Monchen trennen sich die Wege der beiden Findelkinder Martin und Georg allerdings.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men
programme.desc: The successful advertising jingle composer Charlie Harper enjoys his bachelor life in his house on the beach in Malibu. But then his brother, the grumbling, freshly divorced chiropractor Alan and his son Jake moves in. The two contrasting browsing is not always easy to live together, but somehow they have to come to terms. When Charlie suddenly dies, the somewhat non-world internet-billiardar Walden Schmidt buys the beach house and moves in with Alan and Jake. Now it is Alan who stands by his new, inexperienced roommate with advice and action in all situations. / Der erfolgreiche Werbejingle-Komponist Charlie Harper genieSSt sein Junggesellen-Leben in seinem Haus am Strand von Malibu. Doch dann zieht sein Bruder, der schuchterne, frisch geschiedene Chiropraktiker Alan gemeinsam mit seinem Sohn Jake bei ihm ein. Den beiden gegensatzlichen Brudern fallt das Zusammenleben nicht immer leicht, doch irgendwie mussen sie sich arrangieren. Als Charlie plotzlich stirbt, kauft der etwas weltfremde Internet-Milliardar Walden Schmidt das Strandhaus und zieht bei Alan und Jake ein. Nun ist es Alan, der seinem neuen, unerfahrenen Mitbewohner in allen Lebenslagen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht.

programme.title: Funsport

programme.title: Marathon: Wachau Marathon
programme.desc: The Wachau Marathon did not take place last year due to the forecast weather risks. In 2023 Clemens Sigl won 2:44:30 hours for the first time in his career. At that time, the American Ashley Kemton prevailed with 3:14:51 hours. / Im vergangenen Jahr fand der Wachau-Marathon aufgrund der prognostizierten Wetterrisiken nicht statt. 2023 holte sich Clemens Sigl mit 2:44:30 Stunden zum ersten Mal in seiner Karriere den Sieg. Bei den Frauen setzte sich damals die Amerikanerin Ashley Kempton mit 3:14:51 Stunden durch.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evgeni Ignatov / Зала на славата: Евгени Игнатов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: After the initial inspection of a shot farmer, Dr. Blake finds strange inconsistencies. He gradually unravels not only the murder but also the past of the dead man's widow. Previous Chief Inspector Munro is coming back to the city. / След първоначалния оглед на прострелян фермер д-р Блейк намира странни несъответствия. Постепенно разплита не само убийството, но и миналото на вдовицата на мъртвеца. В града се връща и предишният главен инспектор Мънро.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Freestyle and Women, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Свободен стил и жени, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: Due to Lucian Blake's hasty decision to refer to his drunkenness as a reason for a divorce, all his patients cancel his hours, and Inspector Lawson chases him from the area. He even fired him from the position of a police doctor. But with that the trouble is not over - someone kills and hurts people from the doctor's environment. It turns out that behind everything stands the mourner father who lost his daughters because of Dr. Blake. In the end, the killer was captured and Jean scheduled a wedding date. At Christmas, everyone receives a favorite gift and warmth. / Заради прибързаното решение на Лусиън Блейк да посочи пиянството си като причина за развод, всичките му пациенти отменят часовете си, а инспектор Лоусън го гони от участъка. Дори го уволнява от позицията на полицейски лекар. Но с това неприятностите не приключват – някой убива и наранява хора от обкръжението на доктора. Оказва се, че зад всичко стои опечаленият баща, изгубил дъщерите си заради д-р Блейк. В крайна сметка убиецът е заловен, а Джийн насрочва дата за сватба. По Коледа всеки получава любим подарък и топлина.

programme.desc: Due to Lucian Blake's hasty decision to refer to his drunkenness as a reason for a divorce, all his patients cancel his hours, and Inspector Lawson chases him from the area. programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

Nestala
programme.desc: Jill (Amanda Seyfried) returns home after a night shift and reveals that her sister Molly has been abducted. A year ago, Jill managed to escape the kidnapper and is convinced that the same serial killer returned to Molly. Since the killer has left no trace, the police have no evidence and cannot help her. Fearing that Molly would be dead before the morning, Jill goes on a standalone chase to face the killer. Will she have enough time to outsmart him, discover his secrets and save his sister? / Jill (Amanda Seyfried) se vraća kući nakon noćne smjene i otkriva da je njena sestra Molly oteta. Prije godinu dana Jill je uspjela pobjeći otmičaru i uvjerena je da se isti serijski ubojica vratio po Molly. Pošto ubojica nije ostavio nikakav trag, policija nema dokaza i ne može joj pomoći. Strahujući da će Molly biti mrtva prije jutra, Jill kreće u samostalnu potjeru kako bi se suočila s ubojicom.Da li će imati dovoljno vremena da ga nadmudri, otkrije njegove tajne i spasi sestru?

programme.title: Jocker
programme.desc: Nick Wild, a bodyguard and a dice addict, embarks on a vengeful march when his friend rapes a disturbed bully. But what Nick does not know is that the abuser is the son of a powerful mafia boss. The roles are now higher than ever because only one can survive this game. / Nick Wild, tjelohranitelj i ovisnik o kocki, kreće u osvetnički pohod kada njegovu prijateljicu siluje poremećeni nasilnik. No ono što Nick ne zna je da je zlostavljač sin moćnog mafijaškog šefa. Ulozi su sad viši nego ikada jer ovu igru može preživjeti samo jedan.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. programme.title: Maksimir - Rijeka, SuperSport Croatian Football Cup / Maksimir - Rijeka, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.title: Sesvete - Dugo Selo, Handball, Prime Minister League / Sesvete - Dugo Selo, Rukomet, Premijer liga
programme.desc: Handball - Croatian Handball Premier League - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) Handball Premier League is the highest rank of club handball competitions in Croatia. The league is Basic in 1991 under the authority of the Croatian Handball Federation. So far, the 26th season of the Premier League has been played and it is almost incredibly sounding that all the titles have won the Zagreb team, which has performed under several different names over the years. In addition to Zagreb, the NEXE NEXE should be singled out with nine other places won, and formerly the great Metkovic, who has achieved the same success seven times. 12 teams participate in today's format in the league ... / Handball - Croatian Handball Premier League - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Rukometna Premijer liga najviši je rang klupskih rukometnih natjecanja u Hrvatskoj. Liga je osnovna 1991. pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog rukometnog saveza. Do sada je odigrano 26 sezona Premijer lige te gotovo nevjerojatno zvuči podatak da je sve naslove osvojila momčad Zagreba koja je kroz godine nastupala pod više različitih imena. Uz Zagreb treba još izdvojiti i našički Nexe s devet osvojenih drugim mjesta te nekad veliki Metković koji je taj isti uspjeh ostvario sedam puta. U današnjem formatu u ligi sudjeluje 12 momčadi...

programme.title: Maksimir - Rijeka, SuperSport Croatian Football Cup / Maksimir - Rijeka, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.title: ARD Wissen
programme.sub-title: My body. My heart. - young, fit and yet dangerous? / Mein Korper. Mein Herz. - Jung, fit und doch gefahrdet?
programme.desc: Especially in winter, most of us want to warm it. This makes it easier for the body to keep its core temperature of 36.5 to 37.5 ° C. And only with this core temperature can all metabolic processes function optimally, can the body think and act smoothly. But as much as we love warm, actually our body is significantly healthy and more powerful when it is exposed to changing temperatures and, above all, cold eggs. In current research, there are now many knowledge, but also open questions how cold affects the human body and how we can use it for our health. The documentation, as we all benefit from cold beyond top sport and extreme experiences - and can get our body at lower temperatures. The authors meet u. The warehouse worker Katarzyna, who has to defy the cold in a deep cuisine at minus 22 ° C in eight-hour layers. How do you succeed and what role does your individual cold feeling play? How can it be done: more than 33 kilometers in just 17 ° C cold water? What happens in your body? The loss of power of the muscles is considerable and goes quickly. The forwarding of arousal patterns is becoming worse and worse. This can lead to the fact that the entire coordination of the swimming movements fails after just 15 minutes in water below 15 ° C and the person drowns. But Deniz Kayaden tries to train her body so that he can keep his temperature better and better, as it can succeed, for this purpose. Dr. Erich Hohenauer from the University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland. He is also particularly interested in the question of whether cold eggs actually strongly strong the immune system. In addition, he passes investigations with normal, but also cold -tested tests. One of them is the Biohacker Rolf Duda. He wanders through snow landscapes in swimming trunks and regularly goes ice bathing. After a traumatic experience, he differentiated his life and learned healing and mental starch through his cold training. He now passes on his experiences with other people in courses. But how does the mental strengthen work? Here, too, there are new research knowledge from psychology. In terms of top sport, cold therapy is also used ever. The discus thrower Christoph Harting, Olympic winner from 2016, is in the cold chamber at minus 110 ° C. This is intended to increase its delicacy for graceful regeneration and even smaller injuries such as muscle fiber heal faster because body and extreme acts are better bloodly supplied with blood. / Gerade im Winter mogen es die meisten von uns mollig warm. Das macht es dem Korper leichter, seine Kerntemperatur von 36,5 bis 37,5° C zu halten. Und nur mit dieser Kerntemperatur konnen alle Stoffwechselablaufe optimal funktionieren, kann der Korper reibungslos denken und agieren. Doch so sehr wir Warme lieben, eigentlich ist unser Korper deutlich gesunder und leistungsfahiger, wenn er standig wechselnden Temperaturen und vor allem Kaltereizen ausgesetzt ist. In der aktuellen Forschung gibt es mittlerweile viele Erkenntnisse, aber auch noch offene Fragen, wie Kalte auf den menschlichen Korper wirkt und wie wir sie fur unsere Gesundheit nutzen konnen.Die Dokumentation erzahlt, wie wir alle - jenseits von Spitzensport und Extremerlebnissen - von Kalte profitieren und unseren Korper an niedrigere Temperaturen gewohnen konnen. Die Autoren treffen u. a. die Lagerarbeiterin Katarzyna, die in einem Tiefkuhllager bei minus 22° C in Acht-Stunden-Schichten der Kalte trotzen muss. Wie gelingt ihr das und welche Rolle spielt ihr individuelles Kalteempfinden dabei?Begleitet wird auch die Extremschwimmerin Deniz Kayadelen bei ihren Vorbereitungen fur die Durchquerung des Ärmelkanals. Wie ist das zu schaffen: mehr als 33 Kilometer in nur 17° C kaltem Wasser? Was passiert in ihrem Korper? Der Kraftverlust der Muskulatur ist betrachtlich und geht schnell. Die Weiterleitung von Erregungsmustern gelingt immer schlechter. Das kann dazu fuhren, dass schon nach 15 Minuten in Wasser unter 15° C die gesamte Koordination der Schwimmbewegungen versagt und die Person ertrinkt. Aber Deniz Kayadelen versucht ihren Korper so zu trainieren, dass er seine Temperatur immer besser halten kann.Wie das gelingen kann, dazu forscht u. a. Dr. Erich Hohenauer von der University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland. Besonders interessiert ihn auch die Frage, ob Kaltereize tatsachlich das Immunsystem starken. Dazu fuhrt er Untersuchungen mit normalen, aber auch kalteerprobten Proband*innen durch. Einer davon ist der Biohacker Rolf Duda. Er wandert in Badehose durch Schneelandschaften und geht regelmaSSig Eisbaden. Nach einem traumatischen Erlebnis anderte er sein Leben und erfuhr durch sein Kaltetraining Heilung und mentale Starkung. Seine Erfahrungen damit gibt er mittlerweile in Kursen an andere Menschen weiter. Aber wie gelingt die mentale Starkung? Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: Restart for the Viennese Volkstheater with a big festival and three premieres on a weekend neo-director Jan Philipp Gloger starts his term in the Vienna Volkstheater. The director, born in Germany in 1981, who was most recently acting director at the Staatstheater Nernberg, promises more matchdays and more entertainment at the Volkstheater. He put together a new 20-headed ensemble for this, to which audience favorite Samouil Stoyanov belongs as well as the former Burgtheater star Johanna WOALEK. How is it for young art in Austria? Under what conditions can young artists live from their art? Do buyers prefer to be on the safe side and still decide for established positions? Culture Monday is looking for answers to these questions at the art fairs "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" and in galleries. TV entertainer and author Dirk Stermann presents a new book: "The Republic of the Mand", a historical novel around the poet and glowing nationalist Gabriele Dannunzio, who in 1919 called in today's Rijeka and thus offered fascism an experiment field. Dirk Stermann is a guest in the studio. / Neustart fur das Wiener VolkstheaterMit einem groSSen Fest und drei Premieren an einem Wochenende startet Neo-Direktor Jan Philipp Gloger seine Amtszeit im Wiener Volkstheater. Der 1981 in Deutschland geborene Regisseur, der zuletzt Schauspieldirektor am Staatstheater Nurnberg war, verspricht mehr Spieltage und mehr Unterhaltung am Volkstheater. Dafur hat er ein neues 20-kopfiges Ensemble zusammengestellt, zu dem Publikumsliebling Samouil Stoyanov ebenso gehort wie der ehemalige Burgtheater-Star Johanna Wokalek.Wie ist es um die junge Kunst in Österreich bestellt? Unter welchen Bedingungen konnen junge Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler von ihrer Kunst leben? Gehen Kaufer und Kunstsammlerinnen lieber auf Nummer sicher und entscheiden sich doch eher fur etablierte Positionen? Der Kulturmontag sucht Antworten auf diese Fragen auf den Kunstmessen "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" und in Galerien. TV-Entertainer und Autor Dirk Stermann legt ein neues Buch vor: "Die Republik der Irren", ein historischer Roman rund um den Dichter und gluhenden Nationalisten Gabriele DAnnunzio, der 1919 im heutigen Rijeka den "Freistaat Fiume" ausgerufen und damit dem Faschismus ein Experimentierfeld geboten hat. Dirk Stermann ist zu Gast im Studio.

programme.title: Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: The Canadian jazz pianist Oscar Peterson was a legend during his lifetime. On the occasion of his birthday, which on August 15th for the 100th time, the ORF shows a portrait of the piano virtuoso. From none other than Duke Ellington describes the "Maharaya of the Key", Oscar Peterson is one of the most technically sophisticated and melodic pianists in the history of jazz. programme.title: Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.sub-title: Papstlicher als der Papst - Die Piusbruderschaft
programme.desc: The Pius Brotherhood, founded in 1970 by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre, sees the Catholic Church on a wrong way of modernism and rejects the reforms of the second Vatican Council as a contemporary catholic faith. Its to hold on to the old Tridentine liturgy is only the clearest extraordinary characteristic of her innermost beliefs. Nevertheless, talking to the Vatican has been running for many years to restore the full unit of the once excommunicated brotherhood with the Catholic Church - so far without a breakthrough. What principles do the members of the Pius Brotherhood - priest and laypersons - and how do they allow their view of the church, world and society? Peter Beringer's film follows these questions and also outlines the difficult story of the relationship with Rome. / Die Piusbruderschaft, 1970 von Erzbischof Marcel Lefebvre gegrundet, sieht die katholische Kirche auf einem Irrweg des Modernismus und lehnt die Reformen des Zweiten Vatikanischen Konzils als zeitgeistige Verwasserung des katholischen Glaubens ab. Ihr Festhalten an der alten tridentinischen Liturgie ist nur das deutlichste auSSere Merkmal ihrer innersten Überzeugungen. Dennoch laufen seit vielen Jahren Gesprache mit dem Vatikan, um die volle Einheit der einst exkommunizierten Bruderschaft mit der katholischen Kirche wieder herzustellen - bisher ohne Durchbruch. Nach welchen Prinzipien leben die Mitglieder der Piusbruderschaft - Priester und Laien - und wie begrunden sie ihre Sicht auf Kirche, Welt und Gesellschaft? Research is also faced with the challenge of taking gender -specific peculiarities of stronger in order to individually adapt diagnostics and treatment. / Ob Herzinfarkt, Depressionen oder die Wirkung von Medikamenten - das Geschlecht beeinflusst, wie Krankheiten entstehen, verlaufen und behandelt werden. Frauen leben zwar im Durchschnitt langer als Manner, sind mit zunehmendem Alter aber oft weniger gesund. Unterschiede zeigen sich nicht nur in der Lebenserwartung, sondern auch beim Risiko fur bestimmte Erkrankungen, in der Wahrnehmung von Symptomen und im Umgang mit Pravention und Therapie. Auch die Forschung steht vor der Herausforderung, geschlechtsspezifische Besonderheiten starker zu berucksichtigen, um Diagnostik und Behandlung individuell anzupassen.

programme.desc: Celebrating two reasons this year have three city in the Alpine Adria room, which connects a long-term friendship. Klagenfurt am Worthersee has a total of 15 partner city, including Gorz/Gorizia in Friuli Julian Veneto and Neugorz/Nova Gorica in Slovenia. In 2025, the city partnership celebrates its 60-year anniversary. The once divided and reunited city of Gorz, which is located in the Italian territory and its "sister city" Nova Gorica are - in addition to Chemnitz in Germany - also together in the European Capital of Culture. "Go Borderless" is the motto for the common cultural annual program. Grosse names are to be officially lured by culture affine visitors to this year's cultural capital. But above all, there are numerous local artists and smaller initiatives that impart their view of the Capital of Culture. It is often a look into the past combined with hopes for the future. The production "border history (s)" is based on the make-up of various protagonists from Slovenia and Italy of the "soul" of the people who live in the two citys. This "on the go with the neighbor" production should express after a short strain through the common historical past, as the inhabitants of the city of Gorizia and Nova Gorica are currently working together on their appearance in 2025. Economically, culturally and touristically, visitors from near and far are expected throughout and far throughout the region, but the documentation also shows where - apart from the event -related euphoria - synergies can result for the future. The role of the Karntner side - with Klagenfurt am Worthersee as a partner city, and a contribution from the cultural sector with the Ingeborg -Bachmann -Kuppel designed by Armin Guerino - is also illustrated in this context. / Gleich zwei Grunde zu feiern haben heuer drei Stadte im Alpen-Adria-Raum, die eine jahrelange Freundschaft verbindet. Klagenfurt am Worthersee hat insgesamt 15 Partnerstadte, darunter auch Gorz/Gorizia in Friaul Julisch Venetien und Neugorz/Nova Gorica in Slowenien. 2025 feiert die Stadtepartnerschaft ihr 60-jahriges Bestandsjubilaum. Die einst geteilte und wiedervereinte Stadt Gorz, die auf italienischem Staatsgebiet liegt und ihre "Schwesternstadt" Nova Gorica sind heuer - neben Chemnitz in Deutschland - auch gemeinsam Europaische Kulturhauptstadt. "GO borderless" lautet das Motto fur das gemeinsame kulturelle Jahresprogramm.GroSSe Namen sollen von offizieller Seite her kulturaffine Besucher in die heurige Kulturhauptstadt locken. Aber es sind vor allem auch zahlreiche lokale Kunstschaffende und kleinere Initiativen, die ihren Blick auf die Kulturhauptstadt vermitteln. Oft ist es ein Blick in die Vergangenheit, verbunden mit Hoffnungen fur die Zukunft. Die Produktion "Grenz-Geschichte(n)" geht anhand der Erzahlungen verschiedener Protagonisten aus Slowenien und Italien der "Seele" der Menschen auf die Spur, die in den beiden Stadten leben.Diese "Unterwegs beim Nachbarn"-Produktion soll nach einem kurzen Streifzug durch die gemeinsame geschichtliche Vergangenheit zum Ausdruck bringen, wie die Bewohner der Stadte Gorizia und Nova Gorica aktuell gemeinsam an ihrem Auftritt als Kulturhauptstadt 2025 arbeiten. programme.title: Sizilien - Mangelware Wasser
programme.desc: Dryness and lack of water are used to Sicily, but with climate change and mismanagement, the water shortage becomes increasingly extreme. Heat waves and thirst, licking water pipes and dilapidated memory, especially in the Suden, regularly drove that drinking water has to be rationed. The world journal in the agrigent region has looked around in Sicilia's sudwesten, which was most affected in the last year in record heat summer. Many residents get water with canisters from public water points because there is hardly any water from the lines at home. In hotels, the guest are asked to shower only for a maximum of three minutes to save water. A livestock breeder is that he has to bring some of his cattle to a butcher if the pastures continue to interfere. At the same time, water has become a lucrative: water suppliers sell the precious wet at high prices. Design: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini / Auf Sizilien ist man Trockenheit und Wassermangel gewohnt, doch mit dem Klimawandel und Missmanagement wird die Wasserknappheit zusehends extremer. Hitzewellen und Durren, leckende Wasserleitungen und marode Speicher fuhren vor allem im Suden regelmaSSig dazu, dass Trinkwasser rationiert werden muss.Das WELTjournal hat sich in der Region Agrigent im Sudwesten Siziliens umgesehen, die im Rekord-Hitze-Sommer im Vorjahr am schlimmsten betroffen war. Viele Einwohner holen Wasser mit Kanistern von offentlichen Wasserstellen, weil aus den Leitungen zu Hause kaum Wasser kommt. In Hotels werden die Gaste gebeten, nur maximal drei Minuten zu duschen, um Wasser zu sparen. Ein Viehzuchter erzahlt, dass er einen Teil seiner Rinder zum Schlachter bringen muss, wenn die Weiden weiter ausdorren. Gleichzeitig ist Wasser zu einem lukrativen Geschaft geworden: Wasserlieferanten verkaufen das kostbare Nass zu hohen Preisen.Gestaltung: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: The Bleitstatt Moor - from moor to the arable floor to the moor / Das Bleistatter Moor - Vom Moor zum Ackerboden zum Moor
programme.desc: The Bleitstatt Moor was once one of the greatest moor areas of Carnato with 600 hectares. In the course of hunger years in the interwar period, the moor was drained to use it for agriculture. As a result, trucks and dung agents with the flowering Tiebel were used unfiltered into the Ossiacher See. As a result, a massive algae plague developed in the lake. After multi -layered project coordinations, the Tiebel 75 hectares were flooded again from 2016 from 2016. As a filter, the removal basin reduces the entry of floating and nutrients into the Ossiacher See and thus once again raise the water quality, but today the large part of the dry-laid flat shares is still used for agriculture. The area around the flooded setting pools increasingly develops into a protected paradise for flora and fauna. And by the way, the species-rich nature, landscape and European protection area with the "Slow Trail" became a harmonious connection with the gentle tourism.The project Bleinstter Moor is the result of a wide range of cooperation between experts from the areas of water ecology, agriculture, nature conservation and tourism. / Das Bleistatter Moor war einst mit 600 Hektar eines der groSSten Moorgebiete Karntens. Im Zuge der Hungerjahre in der Zwischenkriegszeit wurde das Moor trockengelegt, um es landwirtschaftlich zu nutzen. Dadurch wurden Nahrstoffe und Dungemittel mit der durchstromenden Tiebel ungefiltert in den Ossiacher See gespult. In der Folge entwickelte sich im See eine massive Algenplage.So wurden nach vielschichtigen Projektkoordinationen ab 2016 im Mundungsbereich der Tiebel 75 Hektar wieder geflutet. Die entstandenen Absetzbecken verringern als Filter den Eintrag von Schweb- und Nahrstoffen in den Ossiacher See und heben somit wieder die Wasserqualitat.Heute wird der GroSSteil der trockengelegten Flachen im Rahmen des Naturschutzes nach wie vor landwirtschaftlich genutzt. Der Bereich um die gefluteten Absetzbecken entwickelt sich zunehmend zu einem geschutzten Paradies fur Flora und Fauna. Und nebenbei wurde das artenreiche Natur-, Landschafts- und Europaschutzgebiet mit dem "Slow Trail" zu einer harmonischen Verbindung mit dem sanften Tourismus.Das Projekt Bleistatter Moor ist das Ergebnis einer vieljahrigen Kooperation zwischen Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Gewasserokologie, Landwirtschaft, Naturschutz und Tourismus.

programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Burgenland
programme.sub-title: Diversity in the glass - Welschriesling rediscovered / Vielfalt im Glas - Welschriesling neu entdeckt
programme.desc: Almost missed as mass -produced goods for a long time, the Welschriesling has been rediscovered for several years. The range of the second most important white grape variety in Austria is astonishing. From the basic wine for sparkling wine over fresh, dry summer wines to Sussweinen from world call, also in the new style of orange or amphora wines, the Welschriesling shows what it can do. Die Bandbreite der zweitwichtigsten weiSSen Rebsorte Österreichs ist erstaunlich. Vom Grundwein fur Sekt uber frische, trockene Sommerweine bis hin zu SuSSweinen von Weltruf, auch in der neuen Stilistik von Orange- oder Amphorenweinen zeigt der Welschriesling, was er kann. All diese Facetten lassen sich im Burgenland entdecken. Erstmals ist hier auch die so genannte "Wosch-Meisterschaft" ausgetragen worden, eine hochklassige Verkostung dieser aufstrebenden Rebsorte.

programme.title: Sizilien - Mangelware Wasser
programme.desc: Dryness and lack of water are used to Sicily, but with climate change and mismanagement, the water shortage becomes increasingly extreme. Heat waves and thirst, licking water pipes and dilapidated memory, especially in the Suden, regularly drove that drinking water has to be rationed. The world journal in the agrigent region has looked around in Sicilia's sudwesten, which was most affected in the last year in record heat summer. Many residents get water with canisters from public water points because there is hardly any water from the lines at home. In hotels, the guest are asked to shower only for a maximum of three minutes to save water. A livestock breeder is that he has to bring some of his cattle to a butcher if the pastures continue to interfere. At the same time, water has become a lucrative: water suppliers sell the precious wet at high prices. Design: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini / Auf Sizilien ist man Trockenheit und Wassermangel gewohnt, doch mit dem Klimawandel und Missmanagement wird die Wasserknappheit zusehends extremer. Hitzewellen und Durren, leckende Wasserleitungen und marode Speicher fuhren vor allem im Suden regelmaSSig dazu, dass Trinkwasser rationiert werden muss.Das WELTjournal hat sich in der Region Agrigent im Sudwesten Siziliens umgesehen, die im Rekord-Hitze-Sommer im Vorjahr am schlimmsten betroffen war. Viele Einwohner holen Wasser mit Kanistern von offentlichen Wasserstellen, weil aus den Leitungen zu Hause kaum Wasser kommt. In Hotels werden die Gaste gebeten, nur maximal drei Minuten zu duschen, um Wasser zu sparen. Ein Viehzuchter erzahlt, dass er einen Teil seiner Rinder zum Schlachter bringen muss, wenn die Weiden weiter ausdorren. Gleichzeitig ist Wasser zu einem lukrativen Geschaft geworden: Wasserlieferanten verkaufen das kostbare Nass zu hohen Preisen.Gestaltung: Giulia Ottaviano, Daniela Agostini

programme.title: Fokus Europa
programme.desc: Endlich frei!Die drei baltischen Lander Estland, Lettland und Litauen kappen ihre Stromleitungen nach Russland. Damit wird das Baltikum unabhangig von Energielieferungen aus Russland. Die europaische Union unterstutzt die teure Loslosung finanziell, vor allem weil Russland seine Stromlieferungen immer wieder auch ausnutzt, um politischen Druck aufzubauen. Stefan Gehrer war fur Fokus Europa in Litauen und hat die Demontage der Strommasten gefilmt.Dazu im Studio: Gunter Pauritsch, Energieagentur ÖsterreichRusslands stiller KriegDie europaischen Lander sind standig Opfer hybrider Angriffe, hinter denen mutmaSSlich meist Russland steckt. Dieser hybride Krieg findet bereits statt und die EU rustet sich mit GegenmaSSnahmen vor allem zum Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur. Fokus Europa hat das europaische Abwehrzentrum fur hybride Angriffe im finnischen Helsinki besucht.Schweiz startet in den WeltraumIn wenigen Jahren umkreisen zig-tausende Satelliten die Erde und Konzerne hoffen auf ein Milliardengeschaft im All. Deshalb beteiligt sich jetzt auch die Schweiz an der europaischen Weltraumagentur ESA und verspricht verlassliche Schweizer Qualitat fur die Raumfahrt. Marion Flatz-Maser berichtet aus der Schweiz.Moderation: Andreas Mayer-Bohusch
