Franzi ermittelt in diesem dramatischen Fall mit einem neuen Partner: Nick Brandt.Wahrend Dr. Jonas im EKH um das Leben des Abiturienten kampft, finden die Polizisten heraus, dass er in dieser verhangnisvollen Nacht nicht nur von seinem Vater Volker Bruns im Stich gelassen wurde.Stuck fur Stuck zeigt sich der tragische Ablauf der vergangenen Nacht: Sturzbetrunken stellten seine Freunde Tammo vor eine Mutprobe, die ausgerechnet den Kiez-Konig Vito Masia gegen ihn aufbrachte. Die Polizisten Kiki Beutin und Jan Hasselfeld wurden in der Tatnacht gerufen, da Tammo vor einem Haus randaliert hat. Wieso hat er das getan?Die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Franzi und dem neuen Streifenpartner Nick erweist sich als schwierig, auch die anderen Kollegen im PK 21 missbilligen seine vorschnellen Verdachtigungen.

programme.title: Die Bergretter
programme.desc: Years ago, Thomas Brandtner made a fatal decision to hand over his farm without contaminated sites to his daughter Laura. And the Lost now an environmental disaster. Markus gushes Tobi with the question of whether he wants to succeed as head of mountain rescue. Tobi does not understand the excitement, because Markus comes back after his expedition, isn't it? Her father Thomas has a bose idea: a few years ago he hid sheet metal vener with rat poison in a hollow on the glacier. The ice melts due to climate change, and so the flowing flow comes out of the barrels into a nearby stream. The flasser must disappear as quickly as possible without anyone noticing anything. Not Laura either. The scandal was able to cost them the organic seal. But the attempt to bring a barrel with the snowmobile into the valley goes wrong: Thomas storms, and the barrel ends up in a stream where it does even bigger damage. He urgently needs the help of his ex-wife Silke, who has the final gown. Toothic toothing agree and accompanies Thomas to the glacier. But when trying to recover another barrel, there is a roller slide, and the only outcome is blocked. The two are enclosed and the steam of the rat poison are dead. But the slopes are snowed with the water that is possibly contaminated. The snow cannons have to be stopped - a disaster for the community. Elisa puts the pistol on her chest: If she has no clear statement about contamination until the next day at 10 a.m., the machines go back to operation. / Um seinen Hof ohne Altlasten an seine Tochter Laura ubergeben zu konnen, hat Thomas Brandtner vor Jahren eine fatale Entscheidung getroffen. Und die lost nun eine Umweltkatastrophe aus.Markus uberrascht Tobi mit der Frage, ob er seine Nachfolge als Leiter der Bergrettung antreten will. Tobi versteht die Aufregung nicht, denn Markus kommt nach seiner Expedition doch wieder, oder?Die junge Biobauerin Laura Brandtner erhalt einen Anruf vom Landratsamt: Das Wasser in ihrem Fischteich konnte vergiftet sein. Ihr Vater Thomas hat eine bose Ahnung: Vor einigen Jahren hat er Blechfasser mit Rattengift in einer Hohle am Gletscher versteckt. Durch den Klimawandel schmilzt das Eis, und so gelangt die ausgelaufene Flussigkeit aus den Fassern in einen nahe gelegenen Bach.Die Fasser mussen so schnell wie moglich verschwinden, ohne dass jemand etwas davon mitbekommt. Auch Laura nicht. Der Skandal konnte sie das Biosiegel kosten. Doch der Versuch, ein Fass mit dem Schneemobil ins Tal zu bringen, geht schief: Thomas sturzt, und das Fass landet in einem Bach, wo es noch groSSeren Schaden anrichtet.Er braucht jetzt dringend die Hilfe seiner Ex-Frau Silke, die den Schlussel zu einer Pistenraupe hat. Zahneknirschend willigt sie ein und begleitet Thomas zum Gletscher. Doch beim Versuch, ein weiteres Fass zu bergen, kommt es zum Gerollrutsch, und der einzige Ausgang ist versperrt. Die beiden sind eingeschlossen, und die Dampfe des Rattengiftes sind todlich.Elisa Rodder, die neue Tourismusbeauftragte in Ramsau, steckt in den letzten Vorbereitungen fur einen groSSen Ski-Event. Doch die Pisten werden mit dem Wasser beschneit, das moglicherweise kontaminiert ist. Die Schneekanonen mussen gestoppt werden - fur die Gemeinde eine Katastrophe. Elisa setzt Markus die Pistole auf die Brust: Wenn sie bis zum nachsten Tag um 10.00 Uhr keine klare Aussage uber die Kontaminierung hat, gehen die Maschinen wieder in Betrieb.

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.desc: Village helper Katja comes to the aid of a boy in need. In the confession, the little Liam had admitted that he was malted by his older brother. Since Pastor Sonnleitner is bound to the confession secret, he asks Katja to contact Liam's family. Katja stoses on an apparent flagship family, in which violence is accepted as self -evident. She leaves Liam her business card without the parents, Anna and Rainer Mehdamm. When married violence breaks out in the family again and Rainer praised his wife, Liam dares the brave step: he calls Katja and reports that his mother had fallen off the bike and needs help. At first glance, Katja sees that Anna Mehdamm's injuries have nothing to do with a bicycle accident. The violence between the parents is also the reason for the aggression of the older son against his brother. She advised the desperate mother to separate. But that is in the conflict: While Liam clearly stands by his mother, the older Toni, who worshiped his father like a hero, does not want to admit the situation. Anna is looking for the advice of a child psychologist, which is why Katja finds a preliminary slogan for the mother and her children: the old Schafer Hias, who is currently in the hospital and whose farm and herd of sheep Katja, has plenty of space for a small family. He has lived alone since his wife's death and hardly manages his everyday life. Can Anna Mehdamm find a new home with her sons Dorr? Funf episodes "FRUHLING" are repeated at night. / Dorfhelferin Katja kommt einem Jungen in Not zu Hilfe. In der Beichte hatte der kleine Liam zugegeben, dass er von seinem alteren Bruder maltratiert wird.Da Pfarrer Sonnleitner an das Beichtgeheimnis gebunden ist, bittet er Katja, mit Liams Familie Kontakt aufzunehmen. Katja stoSSt auf eine scheinbare Vorzeigefamilie, in der Gewalt jedoch wie selbstverstandlich hingenommen wird.Sie hinterlasst Liam ihre Visitenkarte, ohne dass die Eltern, Anna und Rainer Mehdamm, dies bemerken. Als in der Familie zum erneuten Male eheliche Gewalt ausbricht und Rainer seine Frau verprugelt, wagt Liam den mutigen Schritt: Er ruft bei Katja an und berichtet, seine Mutter sei vom Fahrrad gefallen und brauche Hilfe.Katja sieht auf den ersten Blick, dass Anna Mehdamms Verletzungen nichts mit einem Fahrradunfall zu tun haben. Die Gewalt zwischen den Eltern ist auch der Grund fur die Aggressionen des alteren Sohns gegenuber seinem Bruder. Sie rat der verzweifelten Mutter zur Trennung. Doch die steht im Zwiespalt: Wahrend Liam eindeutig zu seiner Mutter steht, will der altere Toni, der seinen Vater wie einen Helden verehrt, die Situation nicht wahrhaben. Anna sucht den Rat einer Kinderpsychologin.Derweil findet Katja eine vorlaufige Losung fur die Mutter und ihre Kinder: Der alte Schafer Hias, der derzeit im Krankenhaus liegt und dessen Hof und Schafherde Katja versorgt, hat jede Menge Platz fur eine Kleinfamilie. Seit dem Tod seiner Frau lebt er allein und schafft seinen Alltag kaum noch. Kann Anna Mehdamm mit ihren Sohnen dorr vorlaufig ein neues Zuhause finden?Funf Folgen "Fruhling" werden nachts wiederholt.

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.sub-title: Love me when you can / Lieb mich, wenn du kannst
programme.desc: A lovely eagle crosses Katja's "Madels-Day". Actually, she wanted to take a dragon flight with her friends Filippa and Michelle, but not only the animal gets in the way, but also a problematic Schuler Michelles, whom the women meet on their jerk ride. Freddie was missing at school that day. The talented schooler has an extraordinary problematic drug past. Michelle is worried and prefers to ask Freddie's parents. They drove a holiday farm with ponies that does a lot of work and have little understanding for Freddie's school ambitions. After all, he should take over the farm, where does he need a high school diploma? When father Hubert Loffler is in dispute with his son and suffered an alleged heart attack, Katja's help will be necessary so that the farm can continue. And also her thumb for the boy is asked: Freddie wants to write off his Abitur after the father's attack, end school and be aside from the parents. He also stays with his opinion when the heart attack turns out to be a panic attack and Katja finally succeeds in softening the father's hard attitude. Because Freddie's sophisticated school abortion actually has a completely different reason: he is in love and does not want to meet his worshiped one at school for a long time. He simply no longer spend this incredible love. Katja, Michelle and Freddie's mother Christa, to bring the young man back on the way of reason. But in vain. Katja only understands the real reason for Freddie's persistence when she accidentally meets him and his girlfriend in the cinema one evening, where he works as a card emission. / Ein liebeskranker Adler durchkreuzt Katjas "Madels-Tag". Eigentlich wollte sie gemeinsam mit ihren Freundinnen Filippa und Michelle einen Drachenflug wagen.Doch nicht nur das Tier kommt in die Quere, sondern auch ein problematischer Schuler Michelles, dem die Frauen bei ihrer Ruckfahrt begegnen. Freddie fehlte an diesem Tag in der Schule. Der talentierte Schuler hat eine auSSerst problematische Drogen-Vergangenheit.Michelle macht sich Sorgen und will lieber einmal bei Freddies Eltern nachfragen. Die fuhren einen Ferienhof mit Ponys, der viel Arbeit macht, und haben wenig Verstandnis fur Freddies schulische Ambitionen. SchlieSSlich soll er doch den Hof ubernehmen, wofur braucht er da ein Abitur? Als Vater Hubert Loffler daruber in Streit mit seinem Sohn gerat und einen mutmaSSlichen Herzinfarkt erleidet, wird Katjas Hilfe notwendig, damit der Hof weiterlaufen kann.Und auch ihre Fursorge fur den Jungen ist gefragt: Freddie will sein Abitur nach dem Anfall des Vaters abschreiben, die Schule beenden und den Eltern fortan besser zur Seite stehen. Er bleibt auch bei seiner Meinung, als sich der Herzinfarkt als Panikattacke erweist und es Katja schlieSSlich gelingt, die harte Haltung des Vaters aufzuweichen. Denn Freddies plotzlicher Schulabbruch hat eigentlich einen ganz anderen Grund: Er ist unglucklich verliebt und will seine Angebetete nicht langer in der Schule treffen. Er ertragt diese ungluckliche Liebe schlichtweg nicht mehr.Mit vereinten Kraften versuchen Katja, Michelle und Freddies Mutter Christa, den jungen Mann zuruck auf den Weg der Vernunft zu bringen. Doch vergeblich. Den wahren Grund fur Freddies Beharrlichkeit versteht Katja erst, als sie eines Abends zufallig im Kino, wo er als KartenabreiSSer jobbt, auf ihn und seine Freundin trifft.

programme.title: Notruf Hafenkante
programme.sub-title: Ringo, Kim and Sidney / Ringo, Kim und Sidney
programme.desc: Claudia and Tarik catched a 16-year-old who wants to withdraw 1,000 euros from an ATM with a stolen credit card. When trying to bring him home, he escapes, and you will find out that he did not give his real name. In the meantime, Hans and Alexa want to bring the credit card to their owner, Amelie Hartmann, only meet her 14-year daughter Kim and the seven-year son Sidney. From the mother there is no trace. She also did not report the credit card as stolen. And that she makes a long trip, as the daughter claims, does not seem plausible to the police. The case is more and more advisable: Where is the mother? How long has it disappeared? And what do the children know? / Claudia und Tarik erwischen einen 16-Jahrigen, der mit einer gestohlenen Kreditkarte 1000 Euro an einem Geldautomaten abheben will. Beim Versuch, ihn nach Hause zu bringen, entwischt er.Zudem finden sie heraus, dass er nicht seinen richtigen Namen genannt hat. Inzwischen wollen Hans und Alexa die Kreditkarte ihrer Besitzerin, Amelie Hartmann, zuruckbringen, treffen aber nur deren 14-jahrige Tochter Kim und den siebenjahrigen Sohn Sidney an.Von der Mutter fehlt jede Spur. Auch die Kreditkarte hat sie nicht als gestohlen gemeldet. Und dass sie einen langeren Ausflug macht, wie von der Tochter behauptet, erscheint den Polizisten nicht plausibel. Der Fall wirft immer mehr Ratsel auf: Wo steckt die Mutter? Seit wann ist sie verschwunden? Und was wissen die Kinder?

programme.title: Electra K3 E1 (E) / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Electra with Paul runs riding on two horses. Vlasi is running, looking for Nefeli. She enters her father's house and finds Sotiris falling bloodthirsty. Nefeli? Where are they? Danae? / Η Ηλέκτρα με τον Παύλο τρέχουν καβάλα σε δύο άλογα. Ο Βλάσης τρέχει, αναζητώντας τη Νεφέλη. Μπαίνει λαχανιασμένος στο σπίτι του πατέρα της και βρίσκει τον Σωτήρη να κείται αιμόφυρτος. Η Νεφέλη; Πού είναι; Η Δανάη;

programme.title: Pop cooking K9 / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9
programme.desc: Episode: Gifts Gudura. The fencing champion is changing a battlefield and testing her kitchen skills next to chef Andrea Lagos. Η ατσάλινη πρωταθλήτρια ξιφασκίας αλλάζει πεδίο μάχης και δοκιμάζει τις ικανότητές της στην κουζίνα, δίπλα στον σεφ Ανδρέα Λαγό. Μαζί μαγειρεύουν με φασόλια πλακέ Πρεσπών και χυλοπίτες από την Εύβοια.

programme.desc: Isaiah, frustrated by his first marriage that ended up in a divorce, opens a neighborhood office, claiming to everyone that marriage from a neighborhood is the only one who ensures true happiness. (85) / Ο Ησαΐας, απογοητευμένος από τον πρώτο του γάμο που κατέληξε σε διαζύγιο, ανοίγει ένα γραφείο συνοικεσίων, διατυμπανίζοντας σε όλους ότι ο γάμος από συνοικέσιο είναι ο μόνος που εξασφαλίζει την πραγματική ευτυχία. (85)

programme.title: Electra K3 E2 / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. While Harris desperately tries to unite the puzzle pieces, it is realized that many people have disappeared from the island to be a coincidence: Paul and Electra are missing and Domna is afraid of the worst ... / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Ενώ ο Χάρης προσπαθεί απεγνωσμένα να ενώσει τα κομμάτια του παζλ, γίνεται αντιληπτό πως από το νησί έχει εξαφανιστεί πολύς κόσμος για να πρόκειται για σύμπτωση: ο Παύλος και η Ηλέκτρα λείπουν και η Δόμνα φοβάται τα χειρότερα...

programme.title: The E2 child / Το Παιδί Ε2
programme.desc: Artemis realizes that she cannot trust the police, so along with Dimitris are fled by the villa, while the traces of Ivan and Tania are missing. Police are starting a operation to locate them. / Η Άρτεμις συνειδητοποιεί ότι δεν μπορεί να εμπιστεύεται την Αστυνομία και έτσι μαζί με τον Δημήτρη τρέπονται σε φυγή από την έπαυλη, τη στιγμή που τα ίχνη του Ιβάν και της Τάνια αγνοούνται. Η Αστυνομία ξεκινάει επιχείρηση για τους να εντοπίσει.

programme.title: Well he will go too e2 / Καλά Θα Πάει Κι Αυτό Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Eighteen years ago, teenager Paris becomes a victim of violent bowling - and little Michaela saves him with courage. A kiss of friendship that was supposed to become a teenage love. However, in the present, their reunion in the hospital is electric. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Δεκαοχτώ χρόνια πριν, ο έφηβος Πάρις γίνεται θύμα βίαιου μπούλινγκ - και η μικρή τότε Μιχαέλα τον σώζει με θάρρος. Ένα φιλί φιλίας που έμελλε να γίνει εφηβικός έρωτας. Στο παρόν, όμως, η επανένωσή τους στο νοσοκομείο είναι ηλεκτρική.

programme.title: Trapped / Παγιδευμένη
programme.desc: When their daughter falls victim to abduction, Caren and William decide not to indulge in blackmailing the kidnappers and to counterattack. programme.title: Electra K3 E3 / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε3
programme.desc: The series takes us to the 70's to describe to us the story of a woman oppressed by conventions of the time and the confusion of a small island's society. / Η σειρά μάς μεταφέρει στη δεκαετία του 70 για να μας περιγράψει την ιστορία μιας γυναίκας καταπιεσμένης από τις συμβάσεις της εποχής και τον καθωσπρεπισμό μιας μικρής κοινωνίας ενός νησιού.

programme.title: The E3 child / Το Παιδί Ε3
programme.desc: A former champion Tae Kwon Do, Artemis, saves from a murderous attack on teenager Dimitri, who is in the autism spectrum. He quickly finds that as long as the child is alive he continues to be a goal. / Μια πρώην πρωταθλήτρια τάε κβον ντο, η Άρτεμις, σώζει από μια δολοφονική επίθεση τον έφηβο Ντιμίτρι, ο οποίος βρίσκεται στο φάσμα του αυτισμού. Γρήγορα διαπιστώνει ότι όσο το παιδί είναι ζωντανό συνεχίζει να αποτελεί στόχο.

programme.title: Well he will go and that E3 / Καλά Θα Πάει Κι Αυτό Ε3
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Paris and Michaela grew up together in a seaside town. The two, tied to that thread that had no name. It was neither friendship, nor love, nor blood. They were all together. Until it was nothing. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Ο Πάρις και η Μιχαέλα μεγάλωσαν μαζί, σε μια παραθαλάσσια πόλη. Οι δυο τους, δεμένοι με εκείνο το νήμα που δεν είχε όνομα. Δεν ήταν ούτε φιλία, ούτε έρωτας, ούτε αίμα. Ήταν όλα μαζί. Μέχρι που δεν ήταν τίποτα.

programme.title: Atomic Blonde
programme.desc: A MI6 secret agent arrives in Berlin during the Cold War to unravel the murder of a colleague and find a lost list of duplicate agents. (110) / Μια μυστική πράκτορας της MI6 φθάνει στο Βερολίνο κατά τη διάρκεια του Ψυχρού Πολέμου για να εξιχνιάσει τον φόνο ενός συναδέλφου της και να εντοπίσει μία χαμένη λίστα διπλών πρακτόρων. (110)

Η Χρύσα δίνει μια δεύτερη ευκαιρία στον Θοδωρή, αλλά όχι όμως στον Τζώρτζη, καταστρέφοντας έτσι το σχέδιο του Κανέλλου να της μιλήσει για τα αισθήματά του.

programme.title: Mediterranean (E) / Μεσόγειος (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Slovenia. Despite the years that this country lived in the eastern bloc, the echo of Central Europe has never ceased to sound loud in Slovenia. In Ljubljana, a city where western classical music education is a common property of humans, music takes to the streets. / Επεισόδιο: Σλοβενία. Παρά τα χρόνια που η χώρα αυτή έζησε εντός του Ανατολικού μπλοκ, η ηχώ της Κεντρικής Ευρώπης δεν έπαψε ποτέ να ακούγεται δυνατά στη Σλοβενία. Στη Λιουμπλιάνα, μια πόλη όπου η δυτική κλασσική μουσική παιδεία είναι κοινό κτήμα των ανθρώπων, η μουσική βγαίνει στους δρόμους.

programme.title: The music of the world (e) / Οι Μουσικές του Κόσμου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Jazz in Athens. Η εκπομπή παρουσιάζει το Jazz in Athens με τους Έλληνες μουσικούς να μας παρασύρουν με νότες και μέτρα γνήσιας αυθεντικής jazz, να εκφράσουν τα δικά τους blues και να μας παρασύρουν με τη funky-soul made by the Greeks.

programme.title: Your Peggy got married / Η Πέγκυ Σου Παντρεύτηκε
programme.desc: Your Peggy is a 43 -year -old housewife and a mother in a divorce process. During a gathering with her old classmates from high school, Peggy Your fainting and when she meets, she finds that time has returned to school. (120) / Η Πέγκυ Σου είναι μια 43χρονη νοικοκυρά και μητέρα που βρίσκεται σε διαδικασία διαζυγίου. programme.title: Accused E11 (e) / Κατηγορούμενοι Ε11 (Ε)

programme.title: Accused E12 (e) / Κατηγορούμενοι Ε12 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The story of Morgan. programme.title: Loxandra (e) / Λωξάντρα (Ε)
programme.desc: Greek Social Series 1980. Loxandra lives in Constantinople in the mid -19th century. Orphaned by a child, she raised her younger siblings and in her thirties she marries a consul a larger widow, Dimitros. / Ελληνική κοινωνική σειρά παραγωγής 1980. Η Λωξάντρα ζει στην Κωνσταντινούπολη, στα μέσα του 19ου αιώνα. Ορφανή από παιδί, μεγάλωσε τα μικρότερα αδέλφια της και στα τριάντα της παντρεύεται με προξενιό ένα μεγαλύτερό της χήρο, τον Δημητρό.

programme.title: Hippocrates Street E5 (E) / Οδός Ιπποκράτους Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Greek satirical production series 1991. Winding stories of a family, living on Hippocrates Street. The head of the family is Panaretos, a petty -bourgeois accountant of a pharmacy. The rest of the family are all special, each in their own way. / Ελληνική σατιρική σειρά παραγωγής 1991. Εύθυμες ιστορίες μιας οικογένειας, που κατοικεί στην οδό Ιπποκράτους. Επικεφαλής της οικογένειας είναι ο Πανάρετος, μικροαστός λογιστής μιας φαρμακαποθήκης. Τα υπόλοιπα μέλη της οικογένειας είναι όλα τους ιδιαίτερα, ο καθένας με το δικό του τρόπο.

programme.desc: George is more in love than ever, he wants to marry Chryssa and asks her to sign a premarital contract. Chryssa is offended, takes them ... skull and they break up. Georgis regrets Theodore's help. / Ο Τζώρτζης είναι πιο ερωτευμένος από ποτέ, θέλει να παντρευτεί τη Χρύσα και της ζητάει να υπογράψουν προγαμιαίο συμβόλαιο. Η Χρύσα προσβάλλεται, τα παίρνει... κρανίο και χωρίζουν. Ο Τζώρτζης μετανιωμένος ζητάει τη βοήθεια του Θοδωρή.

programme.title: Perimeter (e) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: An informational show that focuses daily on the news and on specific issues, in concentric circles, with a focus on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: The vineyards of the world E1 (e) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Lantente, volcanic wine. On the coast of Africa, the Spanish island of Lanathate turned the disaster into a miracle. The volcanoes had been deserted, but its inhabitants dug hundreds of tiny craters in black sand to cultivate vineyards. / Επεισόδιο: Λανθαρότε, το Κρασί των Ηφαιστείων. Στις ακτές της Αφρικής, το ισπανικό νησί Λανθαρότε μετέτρεψε την καταστροφή σε θαύμα. Τα ηφαίστεια το είχαν ερημώσει, αλλά οι κάτοικοί του έσκαψαν εκατοντάδες μικροσκοπικούς κρατήρες στη μαύρη άμμο για να καλλιεργήσουν αμπέλια.

programme.title: Every place and song K2 (e) / Κάθε Τόπος και Τραγούδι Κ2 (Ε)
programme.desc: In the fountain in Tseeritsana. Laka Souli. An area that many do not know. Η ένδοξη ιστορία από τη μία και η ζοφερή σημερινή πραγματικότητα αποτελούν τα κυρίαρχα στοιχεία της.

programme.title: Only sea e5 (e) / Μόνο Θάλασσα Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Raya Abat, northern underwater gardens. A magnificent journey to the border of two amazing worlds: beyond the turquoise waters of Raya Abat, a paradise with a variety of coral gardens, a multitude of exciting species of fish and giant sponge. / Επεισόδιο: Ράγια Άμπατ, Βόρειοι Υποβρύχιοι Κήποι. programme.title: The secrets of the enchanted K1 E2 (E) Forestry / Τα Μυστικά των Μαγεμένων Δασών Κ1 Ε2 (Ε)

programme.title: To live the poor children / Να Ζήσουν τα Φτωχόπαιδα
programme.desc: Two pairs of brothers, one wealthy and the other poor, fall in love and want to get married. (97) / Δύο ζεύγη αδελφών, το ένα εύπορο και το άλλο φτωχό, ερωτεύονται και θέλουν να παντρευτούν. programme.title: Musikology E10 (E) / Musikology Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Fotis explains to us the Doppler phenomenon and we learn about the music of the country that has won 7 times Eurovision, Sweden! We are talking with saxophonist Melina Paxinou and the famous pianist, George Kontrafouris. / Ο Φώτης μάς εξηγεί το φαινόμενο Doppler και μαθαίνουμε για τη μουσική της χώρας που έχει κερδίσει 7 φορές τη Eurovision, την Σουηδία! Μιλάμε με τη σαξοφωνίστρια Μελίνα Παξινού και με τον διάσημο πιανίστα, Γιώργο Κοντραφούρη.

programme.title: Weaving the world E2 (e) / Υφαίνοντας τον Κόσμο Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Japan. On the small island of Ireomotte, Akiko weaves banana fibers and paints them with plants from her garden. Her creations, honored by Isy Miyake and Museums of Contemporary Art, praise the union of man and nature. / Επεισόδιο: Ιαπωνία. Στο μικρό νησί Ιριομότε, η Ακίκο υφαίνει ίνες μπανάνας και τις βάφει με φυτά από τον κήπο της. Οι δημιουργίες της, που έχουν τιμηθεί από τον Ισέι Μιγιάκε και από μουσεία σύγχρονης τέχνης, εξυμνούν την ένωση του ανθρώπου και της φύσης.

programme.title: History from the distant past K1 E3 (E) / Ιστορία από το Μακρινό Παρελθόν Κ1 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Industrial Revolution and the War in Modern Era. The industrial revolution and the evolution of war in modern times have their roots in the depths of time in that natural process that enriches the ground. / Επεισόδιο: Η Βιομηχανική Επανάσταση και ο πόλεμος στη σύγχρονη εποχή. Η Βιομηχανική Επανάσταση και η εξέλιξη του πολέμου στη σύγχρονη εποχή έχουν τις ρίζες τους στα βάθη του χρόνου στη φυσική εκείνη διαδικασία που εμπλουτίζει το έδαφος.

programme.title: Artemisia Gentieleski: Trauma and Art / Αρτεμίζια Τζεντιλέσκι: Τραύμα και Τέχνη
programme.desc: PREMIERE. It is probably the most famous metoo crime in the Baroque art world. The victim is the 18 -year -old painter, Artemisia Jedilesski. The perpetrator: a well -known colleague of her father artist, who interrupted her in a violent way. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Είναι πιθανόν το πιο διάσημο έγκλημα MeToo στον μπαρόκ καλλιτεχνικό κόσμο. Το θύμα είναι η 18χρονη ζωγράφος, Αρτεμίζια Τζεντιλέσκι. Ο δράστης: ένας γνωστός συνάδελφος καλλιτέχνης του πατέρα της, που τη διακόρευσε με βίαιο τρόπο.

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: The puzzle puzzle of the swamps / O Enigma da Múmia dos Pântanos
programme.desc: Tollund's man is a natural mummy preserved in a Denmarques swamp for over 2,500 years. It is a precious archaeological relic, an exceptional find that offers a rare encounter with the past. When we contemplate this sleeping face that miraculously survived to the centuries, we arise a series of questions: Where did you come from? Who was it? How did you live? What did you do there on the peat, with a rope around your neck? Was it hanged? Why? In what context? A true "argued case" for scientists who, since its discovery in 1950, has tried to unravel this puzzle. Especially because Tollund's man is not an isolated case: hundreds of bodies were found in the northwest of Europe, most of them victims of violent deaths. Conceived as a true detective history, Favitski's Alexis documentary follows the steps of scientists and gathers clues as pieces of a puzzle. A puzzle that describes the history of an ancestor, a society, of an era, where men and women lived and sometimes died in terrible conditions. From the Denmark to the United Kingdom, passing through France, we follow the investigation, a question, by peat, laboratory and museums that hold fascinating treasures, to rebuild an era through experimental archeology and tell the final moments of the victims as faithful as possible. / O Homem de Tollund e uma múmia natural preservada num pântano dinamarques há mais de 2.500 anos. Trata-se de uma preciosa relíquia arqueologica, um achado excecional que oferece um raro encontro com o passado. Quando contemplamos este rosto adormecido que sobreviveu milagrosamente aos seculos, surgem-nos uma serie de questões: De onde veio? Quem era? Como vivia? O que fazia ali, na turfa, com uma corda ao pescoço? Foi enforcado? Por que motivo? Em que contexto? Um verdadeiro "caso arquivado" para os cientistas que, desde a sua descoberta em 1950, tem tentado desvendar este enigma. Sobretudo porque o Homem de Tollund nao e um caso isolado: foram encontrados centenas de corpos nas turfeiras do noroeste da Europa, a maioria deles vítimas de mortes violentas. Concebido como uma verdadeira historia de detetives, o documentário de Alexis de Favitski segue os passos dos cientistas e reúne pistas, como peças de um puzzle. Um puzzle que descreve a historia de um antepassado, de uma sociedade, de uma era, onde homens e mulheres viveram e morreram, por vezes, em condições terríveis. Da Dinamarca ao Reino Unido, passando por França, acompanhamos a investigaçao, questao a questao, por turfeiras, laboratorios e museus que guardam tesouros fascinantes, para reconstruir uma era atraves da arqueologia experimental e contar os momentos finais das vítimas da forma mais fiel possível.

programme.title: The culpation of the Mediterranean: piracy, abduction and slavery / A Maldiçao do Mediterrâneo: Pirataria, Rapto e Escravatura
programme.desc: In the 1530 decade, Balthasar Sturmer, the son of a German merchant, embarks on a Corsican Crsary Ship to hunt Ottoman ships in the Mediterranean. The moment he plans to become the captain of his own ship, he falls into the hands of Ottoman-costers and sold as a slave to the North Africa. In the 2019 summer, marine archaeologist Timmy Gambin and his Malta University team make a sensational discovery: from a depth of 126 meters, a diver robot provides images that reveal the contours of a wreck that scientists date from the 16th century. Danielle Proskar's documentary sheds light on a little known aspect of European history: piracy and slavery in the Mediterranean - human trafficking governed by law as an instrument for obtaining personal power and enrichment. A game of greed and power. / Na decada de 1530, Balthasar Sturmer, filho de um comerciante alemao, embarca num navio corsário cristao para caçar navios mercantes otomanos no Mediterrâneo. No momento em que planeia tornar-se capitao do seu proprio navio, cai nas maos de corsários otomanos e e vendido como escravo para o Norte de África. No verao de 2019, o arqueologo marinho Timmy Gambin e a sua equipa da Universidade de Malta fazem uma descoberta sensacional: a partir de uma profundidade de 126 metros, um robô mergulhador fornece imagens que revelam os contornos de um naufrágio que os cientistas datam do seculo XVI. O documentário de Danielle Proskar lança luz sobre um aspeto pouco conhecido da historia europeia: a pirataria e a escravatura no Mediterrâneo - tráfico humano regido por lei como instrumento para obter poder e enriquecimento pessoal. Um jogo de ganância e poder.

programme.desc: Sugandhi Gadadhar, the Wildlife and Explorer of the National Geographic, reveals the playful and resilient life of the otters in one of the most quickly changing water courses in India. Passed on the lush swamps and the quiet waters of the Kaveri River, the documentary reveals a rare vision of the family life of the otters, its survival strategies and interactions with other species. But as pollution and dynamite fishing threaten the delicate balance of the dwelling of otters, fishermen and otters often come in conflict. Over five years, Sugandhi Gadadhar accompanies a family of otters while facing these challenges. / Sugandhi Gadadhar, cineasta de vida selvagem e exploradora da National Geographic, revela a vida lúdica e resiliente das lontras-indianas num dos cursos de água que mais rapidamente mudam na Índia. Passado nos exuberantes pântanos e nas águas tranquilas do rio Kaveri, o documentário revela uma visao rara da vida familiar das lontras, das suas estrategias de sobrevivencia e interações com outras especies. Mas, à medida que a poluiçao e a pesca com dinamite ameaçam o equilíbrio delicado do habitat das lontras, os pescadores e as lontras entram frequentemente em conflito. Ao longo de cinco anos, Sugandhi Gadadhar acompanha uma família de lontras enquanto enfrentam estes desafios.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Nottingham Forest - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: In all competitions, Arsenal have won their last six home games against Nottingham Forest by an aggregate score of 19-2. The Gunners are unbeaten in 14 games on home soil against Forest since a 3-1 defeat back in March 1989. Nottingham Forest have won just two out of 16 Premier League matches against Arsenal and both wins came at the City Ground, in 1996-97 and 2022-23.

programme.title: Burnley vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Burnley have lost 14 of their 18 Premier League matches against Liverpool, including each of their last five in a row since a 1-0 win at Anfield in January 2021. Liverpool have won eight of their nine away Premier League matches at Turf Moor against Burnley, winning the last six in a row. The Reds have won seven away top-flight games in a row against three teams previously: West Brom, Norwich and Crystal Palace.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United, though they failed to win either game last season for the first time since 2020-21. Manchester United have inflicted 25% of Pep Guardiola’s total home Premier League defeats as Man City manager, with the Red Devils winning four times there against the Spaniard. They are looking for consecutive wins at the Etihad for the first time since March 2021.

programme.title: West Ham United vs Tottenham Hotspur - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: West Ham have won just one of their last seven Premier League matches against Tottenham Hotspur, a 2-1 away win in December 2023. Each of the last three Premier League meetings between West Ham and Spurs at the London Stadium have ended as 1-1 draws – Spurs are winless in five league visits since a 3-2 win in November 2019.

programme.title: Barcelona vs Valencia - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Barcelona have not lost any of their last 10 matches against Valencia in LaLiga, their second-best unbeaten run against Los Che in their history in the competition, after a run of 13 matches between 2007 and 2013. Valencia have conceded at least one goal in each of their last 21 away games against FC Barcelona in LaLiga, since a 1-0 win in October 2003 under Rafa Benítez, their worst current run without keeping a clean sheet against the same opponent in the competition.

programme.title: Real Sociedad vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 4 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Real Sociedad have lost their last four LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in the last three. The San Sebastián side have never lost four consecutive matches without scoring against Los Blancos in the history of the competition. Real Madrid have won 12 of the 21 matches they have played at Anoeta against Real Sociedad in LaLiga in the 21st Century, becoming the away team with the most wins at the San Sebastian sides ground in the competition since then.

programme.title: PSG vs Lens - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 4 - Mini match
programme.desc: Paris SG have won their last five Ligue 1 games against Lens, their best run ever against them and as many wins as in the previous 13 encounters in the top flight. Paris SG are unbeaten in their last nine home matches against Lens in Ligue 1 after losing the previous five.

programme.title: Athletic Club vs Arsenal FC - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD1
programme.desc: This will be the first competitive meeting between Athletic Club and Arsenal, and just the third time the Lions have faced an English opponent in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League. If Arsenal win this game, they will become the first side in European Cup/UEFA Champions League history to win six consecutive matches against Spanish sides. Indeed, they have won all five of their matches against Spanish opposition across the last two campaigns.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Olympique de Marseille - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD1
programme.desc: Real Madrid have won all four of their games against Marseille in European competition. If they win this match, Marseille will be the opponent they have beaten the most times in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League while maintaining a 100 percent record. Only against FC Porto have Marseille suffered more defeats in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League than they have against Real Madrid. Indeed, Los Blancos are the opponent they’ve faced most often across the two competitions while losing every time.

programme.title: Caotutifruti is Astrobot 2 / Caotutifruti Je Astrobot 2

programme.title: Retro Migz1 - Nfs Most Wanted
programme.desc: We return to 2005. year and we recall the ninth part of the popular franchise Need for Speed. Over the years, this continuation has gained a cult status and a large number of fans. / Vraćamo se u 2005. godinu i prisećamo se devetog dela popularne franšize Need for Speed. Tokom godina, upravo ovaj nastavak je stekao kultni status i veliki broj fanova.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League
programme.desc: We take you to the world of hybrid football in which a player is operating a car that strives to control the ball greater than yourself. The goal of the game is, as in football, score. / Vodimo vas u svet hibridnog fudbala u kome igrač upravlja automobilom koji nastoji da kontroliše loptu veću od sebe. programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Darby Vs Langowski / Borilački sport - MMA: Darby vs Langowski
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Fontes Vs Horvath / Borilački sport - MMA: Fontes vs Horvath
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Currently, this competition is made up of 20 teams, and after the end of the season, the weakest 4 teams go to the lower ranking competition, (series b), and from the series B the best 4 come to Series A. / Serija A (port. Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A) je najviši nivo fudbalskog takmičenja u Brazilu. Trenutno, ovo takmičenje je sastavljeno od 20 timova, a po završetku sezone, najslabija 4 tima idu u niži rang takmičenja, (Seriju B), a iz Serije B najbolja 4 dolaze u Seriju A.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Zlatibor - Vojvodina / Košarka - KLS: Zlatibor - Vojvodina
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: Zenit - CSKA / Košarka - VTB liga: Zenit - CSKA
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Hockey (M): Olimpija - VSV, Ice Hockey League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Olimpija - VSV, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. There are 14 teams in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: Maribor (Tuesday); On Tuesday's Good Morning show, there is, among other things, a real journey through time and space. First, we will look at the stars - learn about the intercourse, look at why scientists are talking about the imminent proof of life on Mars, and admire the red -colored northern glow. On Earth, we will stop in Maribor, where an athlete, musician and volunteer Iztok Kočevar will visit us. He is waiting for charity cycling as much as 2000 kilometers - from Maribor to Istanbul. You will also learn how to get healthy. The guest will be a physiotherapist who will remind us of the importance of movement, muscle maintenance, balance and strong bones - that life will remain full and independent in mature years. The last hour will be dedicated to music - more specifically vinyl records. From the invention of Emil Berliner to today's collectible culture - Domen Kozola will reveal to us why the plates are still maintaining their magic and value. Finally, black and white nostalgia. From the television archive we will revive the harvests, grapes harvests and the export of wine from the 1960s and 70s. This time, viewers will decide which reporting we will see together. Andrej Geržina will move to the harvest for one day, and the show will be directed by Katja Treer. / Maribor (torek); V torkovi oddaji Dobro jutro vas med drugim čaka pravo popotovanje skozi čas in prostor. Najprej bomo dvignili pogled k zvezdam – spoznali medzvezdni komet, pogledali, zakaj znanstveniki govorijo o skorajšnjem dokazu življenja na Marsu, ter občudovali rdeče obarvan severni sij. Na Zemlji pa se bomo ustavili v Mariboru, kjer nas bo obiskal športnik, glasbenik in prostovoljec Iztok Kočevar. Čaka ga dobrodelno kolesarjenje dolgo kar 2000 kilometrov – od Maribora do Istanbula. Izvedeli boste tudi, kako se zdravo starati. Gostja bo fizioterapevtka, ki nas bo spomnila, kako pomembno je gibanje, ohranjanje mišic, ravnotežja in močnih kosti – da bo življenje tudi v zrelejših letih ostalo polno in samostojno. Zadnja ura bo posvečena glasbi – natančneje vinilnim ploščam. Od izuma Emila Berlinerja do današnje zbirateljske kulture – Domen Kozole nam bo razkril, zakaj plošče še vedno ohranjajo svojo čarobnost in vrednost. Za konec pa še črno-bela nostalgija. Iz televizijskega arhiva bomo obudili trgatve, letine grozdja in izvoz vina iz 60-ih in 70-ih let. Tokrat boste gledalci odločali, katero reportažo si bomo skupaj ogledali. Andrej Geržina se bo za en dan preselil na trgatev, oddajo pa bo vodila Katja Treer.

programme.desc: R: Vilar Mile ... We have followed the Vilenica International Literary Festival, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year and is under the motto of the Beautiful New World - New Rules of Being. We talked with the central guests and the winners of the festival Georgi Mr. Among other things, they explained to us their view of the central theme of the festival. We visited the 13th Biennial of Puppet Creators of Slovenia, which was held in Maribor. In addition to the best Slovenian puppet shows of the past two seasons, this year's puppet technology was at the forefront, which is both art and crafts and is crucial for puppet creation. At the end of the Biennale, they presented the Klemencic Award for Lifetime Achievement in the field of puppet creativity and was awarded to Silvan Omerzu. The versatile puppet and artistic creator, set designer and director will also be a guest in the studio. After 85 years, the alienated picture of Mary with a child on the throne with Vittore Carpaccia saints from Padua returns to the Piran monastery church of St. Francis. It is a historical moment that both diplomacy and the profession have been in favor of decades. We present the background of the image of the picture why she was taken to Italy and her journey back to Piran. / R: Vilar Mile... Spremljali smo mednarodni literarni festival Vilenica, ki letos slavi svojo 40. obletnico in poteka pod geslom Krasni novi svet – nova pravila bivanja. Pogovarjali smo se z osrednjimi gosti in nagrajenci festivala Georgijem Gospodinovom, Majo Haderlap, Ano Svetel. Med drugim so nam pojasnili tudi svoj pogled na osrednjo temo festivala. Obiskali smo 13. Bienale lutkovnih ustvarjalcev Slovenije, ki je potekal v Mariboru. Poleg najboljših slovenskih lutkovnih predstav preteklih dveh sezon je bila letos v ospredju lutkovna tehnologija, ki je tako umetnost kot obrt in je ključna za lutkovno ustvarjanje. Ob koncu bienala so podelili Klemenčičevo nagrado za življenjsko delo na področju lutkovne ustvarjalnosti, prejel jo je Silvan Omerzu. Vsestranski lutkovni in likovni ustvarjalec, scenograf in režiser bo tudi gost v studiu. Po 85 letih se odtujena slika Marija z detetom na prestolu s svetniki Vittoreja Carpaccia iz Padove vrača v piransko samostansko cerkev sv. Frančiška. Gre za zgodovinski trenutek, za katerega sta se tako diplomacija kot stroka zavzemali več desetletij. Predstavljamo ozadje nastanka slike, zakaj so jo odpeljali v Italijo in njeno pot nazaj v Piran.

programme.desc: 1. Delmichelangelo was from a faithful aristocratic family who did not appreciate artists and their work, so he resisted his father in his teens and went to Florence. There he attracted the attention of the Medicians. At that time, he also had 23 -year -old Leonardo da Vinci in Florence, who then found a client in the court of Milan at the Duke there. In Italian city countries, despite the cultural rebirth due to constant wars and fights for power, it was very restless, so the artists had to prove themselves all the time. While Leonardo in Milan, with his works, which was also the last dinner, he strengthened his fame, Michelangelo had to do his best to prove his exceptionality. Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty / Great Britain / 2024 / Director: Emma Frank. / 1.delMichelangelo je bil iz verne aristokratske družine, ki ni cenila umetnikov in njihovega dela, zato se je v najstniških letih uprl očetu in odšel v Firence. Tam je pritegnil pozornost Medičejcev. Takrat je imel v Firencah atelje tudi 23 let starejši Leonardo da Vinci, ki je nato naročnika našel na milanskem dvoru pri tamkajšnjem vojvodi. V italijanskih mestnih državah je bilo takrat kljub kulturnemu preporodu zaradi nenehnih vojn in bojev za oblast zelo nemirno, zato sta se morala umetnika kljub slavi ves čas dokazovati. Medtem ko je Leonardo v Milanu s svojimi deli, med katerimi je bila tudi Zadnja večerja, utrjeval svojo slavo, se je moral Michelangelo še bolj potruditi, da bi dokazal svojo izjemnost.RENAISSANCE: THE BLOOD AND THE BEAUTY / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Emma Frank.

programme.title: Across Planks: Lublin, Mon. / Čez planke: Lublin, pon.
programme.desc: The broadcast across the planks takes us to Lublin, a city in the east of Poland, where history and present are intertwined every step of the way. Mojca begins the path between the corrugated cereal fields, just a stone's throw away from the Ukrainian border. In the old town, it discovers a digital portal that connects Lublin and Vilno - a symbol of an early idea of ​​a united Europe. At Lublin Castle, he visits the Chapel of the Holy Trinity, where the prayers were accompanied by the signing of the famous Polish-Lithuanian Union, one of the first attempts to connect in Europe. Walking around the city reveals a characteristic Lublin Renaissance, co -designed by numerous foreign artistic and trade communion. Today's Lublin is also a modern intersection: Ukrainians who have settled down or help refugees here in the center of Baobab and the municipality. We also get to know innovators - among them the creators of small delivery robots Mateusz and porridge driving the streets. The university city boasts a rich research tradition, while the countryside preserves the memory of farm life, the legend of Kozl and the centuries -old fruit estate. Lublin was an important Jewish center, whose memory revives the Cultural Center of the Grodzka Gate, but today the tradition is intertwined with a lively concert event. The show ends with a view to the future - Lublin will be the European Capital of Culture with the slogan Reunion in 2029. / Oddaja Čez planke nas popelje v Lublin, mesto na vzhodu Poljske, kjer se na vsakem koraku prepletata zgodovina in sedanjost. Mojca začne pot med valovitimi žitnimi polji, le streljaj od ukrajinske meje. V starem mestnem jedru odkrije digitalni portal, ki v živo povezuje Lublin in Vilno – simbol zgodnje ideje združene Evrope. V Lublinskem gradu obišče kapelo svete Trojice, kjer so molitve spremljale podpis znamenite poljsko-litovske unije, enega prvih poskusov nadnacionalnega povezovanja v Evropi. Sprehod po mestu razkrije značilno lublinsko renesanso, ki jo je sooblikovalo številno tuje umetniško in trgovsko občestvo. Današnji Lublin pa je tudi sodobno križišče: v centru Baobab in na mestni občini delujejo Ukrajinci, ki so se tu ustalili ali pomagajo beguncem. Spoznamo tudi inovatorje – med njimi ustvarjalca malih dostavnih robotkov Mateusz in Kaša, ki vozijo po ulicah. Univerzitetno mesto se ponaša z bogato raziskovalno tradicijo, podeželje pa ohranja spomin na kmečko življenje, legendo o kozlu in stoletne sadjarske posesti. Lublin je bil pomembno judovsko središče, katerega spomin oživlja kulturni center Grodzka vrata, danes pa se tradicija prepleta z živahnim koncertnim dogajanjem. Oddaja se zaključi s pogledom v prihodnost – Lublin bo leta 2029 Evropska prestolnica kulture s sloganom Reunion.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: The paradise of the ladies / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Treaty by her boyfriend, Teresa Sen goes from village and flees to the big city. programme.title: It is happening: episode 6 / Està passant: Episodi 6
programme.desc: Satirical information presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the lactuality of the day. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily news that collects the most prominent events in Catalan, state and international. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: No FICCIO: Two children a day / Sense ficcio: Dos nens al dia
programme.desc: Four Palestinian boys in thirteen and fifteen were detained in 2016 for throwing stones to Israeli soldiers. The military went to their house in the middle of the night, interrogated them, judged them and sentenced them to prison. / Quatre nois palestins dentre tretze i quinze anys van ser detinguts lany 2016 per haver tirat pedres a soldats israelians. Els militars els van anar a buscar a casa seva en plena nit, els van interrogar, els van jutjar i els van condemnar a penes de preso.

programme.title: No FICCIO: Sharid: grow or die in Palestine / Sense ficcio: Sharid: Creixer o morir a Palestina
programme.desc: A documentary that portrays the life and everyday of three Palestinian children to reveal to what extent their childhood is being marked by the political and social circumstances that surround them.Nadeem, Mayar and Watan are trapped in a life marked by the conflict and military occupation in the West Bank. We follow them while walking through the streets recently razed by the Israeli occupation army or when they go to the hospital or the cemetery to visit some of their relatives and we verify the daily violence they face every day. With moments of tenderness, violence, anger and delicacy we verify how the daily life of Palestinian children is marked by uncertainty and violence, despite their innocent nature and we witness how children never stop being children, despite their uncertain future. / Un documental que retrata la vida y cotidianeidad de tres niños palestinos para revelarnos hasta que punto su niñez está siendo marcada por las circunstancias políticas y sociales que los rodean.Nadeem, Mayar y Watan se encuentran atrapados en una vida marcada por el conflicto y la ocupacion militar en Cisjordania. Los seguimos mientras pasean por calles recientemente arrasadas por el ejercito de ocupacion israelí o cuando van al hospital o al cementerio para visitar a algunos de sus familiares y comprobamos la violencia cotidiana a la que hacen frente cada día. Con momentos de ternura, violencia, rabia y delicadeza comprobamos como el día a día de los niños palestinos está marcada por la incertidumbre y la violencia, a pesar de su naturaleza inocente y somos testigos de como los niños nunca dejan de ser niños, a pesar de su futuro incierto.

programme.title: Mes 324
programme.desc: Debate space presented by the Marina Romero in which ideas and points of view are confronted with the dinteres and lactual issues. Catalonia, in particular, and the world, in general, are experiencing moments of great transformation. / Espai de debat presentat per la Marina Romero en què es confronten idees i punts de vista sobre els temes dinterès i lactualitat. Catalunya, en particular, i el mon, en general, estan vivint moments de gran transformacio.

A meeting full of knowledge and monitoring of the events of the day, but also with very deDrettement and with several collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrpam Si Pots: Episodi 161 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 161
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this Question and Answer Contest in which six contestants compete to win the jar. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on curiosities and use word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: It is happening: episode 6 / Està passant: Episodi 6
programme.desc: Satirical information presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the lactuality of the day. The space also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on the lactuality and interview their main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily news that collects the most prominent events in Catalan, state and international. From Monday to Friday, Toni Cruanyes is in charge of presenting the news of the day. / Informatiu diari que recull els esdeveniments mes destacats en làmbit català, estatal i internacional. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: No FICCIO: Two children a day / Sense ficcio: Dos nens al dia
programme.desc: Four Palestinian boys in thirteen and fifteen were detained in 2016 for throwing stones to Israeli soldiers. The military went to their house in the middle of the night, interrogated them, judged them and sentenced them to prison. / Quatre nois palestins dentre tretze i quinze anys van ser detinguts lany 2016 per haver tirat pedres a soldats israelians. Els militars els van anar a buscar a casa seva en plena nit, els van interrogar, els van jutjar i els van condemnar a penes de preso.

programme.title: No FICCIO: Sharid: grow or die in Palestine / Sense ficcio: Sharid: Creixer o morir a Palestina
programme.desc: A documentary that portrays the life and everyday of three Palestinian children to reveal to what extent their childhood is being marked by the political and social circumstances that surround them.Nadeem, Mayar and Watan are trapped in a life marked by the conflict and military occupation in the West Bank. We follow them while walking through the streets recently razed by the Israeli occupation army or when they go to the hospital or the cemetery to visit some of their relatives and we verify the daily violence they face every day. With moments of tenderness, violence, anger and delicacy we verify how the daily life of Palestinian children is marked by uncertainty and violence, despite their innocent nature and we witness how children never stop being children, despite their uncertain future. / Un documental que retrata la vida y cotidianeidad de tres niños palestinos para revelarnos hasta que punto su niñez está siendo marcada por las circunstancias políticas y sociales que los rodean.Nadeem, Mayar y Watan se encuentran atrapados en una vida marcada por el conflicto y la ocupacion militar en Cisjordania. Los seguimos mientras pasean por calles recientemente arrasadas por el ejercito de ocupacion israelí o cuando van al hospital o al cementerio para visitar a algunos de sus familiares y comprobamos la violencia cotidiana a la que hacen frente cada día. Con momentos de ternura, violencia, rabia y delicadeza comprobamos como el día a día de los niños palestinos está marcada por la incertidumbre y la violencia, a pesar de su naturaleza inocente y somos testigos de como los niños nunca dejan de ser niños, a pesar de su futuro incierto.

programme.title: Mes 324
programme.desc: Debate space presented by the Marina Romero in which ideas and points of view are confronted with the dinteres and lactual issues. Catalonia, in particular, and the world, in general, are experiencing moments of great transformation. / Espai de debat presentat per la Marina Romero en què es confronten idees i punts de vista sobre els temes dinterès i lactualitat. Catalunya, en particular, i el mon, en general, estan vivint moments de gran transformacio.

programme.title: News 3/24 / Notícies 3/24
programme.desc: Review of the latest news Catalan, Spanish and international. programme.title: Laula rites: Arturo Blasco Quartet / Ritmes a laula: Arturo Blasco Quartet
programme.desc: Catalan artists and groups show their talent in small acoustic sessions performed in a record study. The Sergio Belloso and Friends, the Catroi Quartet, Kibo or Tazuff are some of the performers that appear in this space. / Artistes i grups catalans mostren el seu talent en petites sessions acústiques realitzades en un estudi de gravacio. Els Sergio Belloso and Friends, el Catroi Quartet, Kibo o Tazuff son alguns dels intèrprets que apareixen en aquest espai.

programme.title: Jazz a lestudi
programme.desc: A space that is a blow to the jazz landscape and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows to see artists such as Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador and Horacio Fumero in their natural fields: the studies of Gravation. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del jazz i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes com Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador i Horacio Fumero en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: Els matins
programme.desc: TV3 daily morning macroprogram presented by journalist Ariadna Oltra. Lespai includes reports, interviews, social gatherings and debates. / Macroprograma matinal diari de TV3 que presenta la periodista Ariadna Oltra. Lespai inclou reportatges, entrevistes, tertúlies i debats.

programme.title: FIRST FOOTBALL DIVISION F / Primera Division de Fútbol Sala F
programme.desc: Sixteen teams make up the first Iberdrola de Fútbol, ​​the highest female competition in the country. After 30 days of regular league, the four best teams fight in the qualifiers for the title. The Navalcarnero Futsi defends Corona. / Dieciseis equipos componen la Primera Iberdrola de Fútbol Sala, la máxima competicion femenina del país. Tras 30 jornadas de liga regular, los cuatro mejores equipos pelean en las eliminatorias por el título. El Futsi de Navalcarnero defiende corona.

programme.title: Mundial de rugby femenino
programme.desc: England hosts from August 22 to 27 the Women's Rugby World Cup dispute. / Inglaterra acoge del 22 al 27 de agosto la disputa del Mundial de rugby femenino.

programme.title: Mundial de mountain bike
programme.desc: The Swiss town of Valais hosts this World Cup until September 14. The contest has field tests through, electric bicycle, pump track and resistance, among others. An unavoidable appointment for all mountain bike enthusiasts. / La localidad suiza de Valais acoge este mundial hasta el 14 de septiembre. El certamen cuenta con pruebas de campo a traves, bicicleta electrica, pump track y resistencia, entre otras. Una cita ineludible para todos los entusiastas de la bicicleta de montaña.

programme.title: FIRST FOOTBALL DIVISION M / Primera Division de Fútbol Sala M
programme.desc: Spain can boast of having the best league in the world of living room. 16 teams make up the First Division, eight of which fight for the title in the playoffs. Cartagena, current champion, Barcelona, ​​Murcia and Inter are the great favorites to the title. / España puede presumir de tener la mejor liga del mundo de fútbol sala. 16 equipos conforman la Primera Division, ocho de los cuales pelean por el título en los playoffs. El Cartagena, actual campeon, Barcelona, Murcia e Inter son los grandes favoritos al título.

programme.title: WTA: San Sebastián
programme.desc: The Royal Tennis Club of San Sebastián hosts the dispute of this tournament that is incorporated into the WTA calendar with category 125. The action takes place from September 8 to 13. Among the participants, Mayar Sherif and Sara Bejlek stand out. / El Real Club de Tenis de San Sebastián acoge la disputa de este torneo que se incorpora al calendario WTA con categoría 125. La accion transcurre del 8 al 13 de septiembre. De entre las participantes, destacan Mayar Sherif y Sara Bejlek.

programme.title: Mundial de atletismo
programme.desc: The capital of Japan hosts one of the sports events of the year. From September 13 to 21, Tokyo houses the athletics World Cup dispute. programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. programme.title: Mountain Life - dream house wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: From the forested mountain tops of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the east of Appalachen about soon Mountain with its grandiose alpine sports, the Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the Rockies to Hawaiis Tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote, beautiful mountain varieties in the United States, which hardly anyone knows. They are the perfect jerking point for stressed city and swinged families who escape from traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And as different as the mountain destinations are, the real estate are so different, because, dependent on budgets and giftability, there are almost everything-from the rustic log hat with wood stove to the bamboo-bungalow with a volcanic view to a full-glazed design object with a private spa. The visual documentary series accompanies mountain fans in their search for the dream house. / Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene, atemberaubend schone Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles - von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem SPA. Die bildgewaltige Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.desc: Compared to a new building, an old house already has character and a story. Many know how to do this and enjoy it. programme.desc: Three men have decided to devote their life to simple survival. And not as simple as it sounds at first.
